sloka: यदि त्ववश्यं वस्तव्यं कर्त्तव्यं च पितुर्वच: ।अहमेव निवत्स्यामि चतुर्दश समा वने ॥ २.१११.२६॥
transliteration: yadi tvavaśyaṁ vastavyaṁ karttavyaṁ ca piturvaca: ।ahameva nivatsyāmi caturdaśa samā vane ॥ 2.111.26॥

translations.english: If it is absolutely essential to live in the forest in accordance with the command of my father, I myself shall also dwell in the forest for fourteen years.
